test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 10 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term.

SECURITY : MKCIRUNE : : UNBIASED : ?
solution:
The position of letters according to English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f390eb1aa5eef27c267010a8106c7b83cfbeaa1b6c945402f538a1e70a0d41b.png] 

**Logic**: The first two and last two letters are getting -6 and +6 respectively, and the four middle letters are getting arranged alphabetically.

SECURITY : MKCIRUNE

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/416d16995d6d6f9ef2944d3485addeef1a8282b3e423eacc45a54fbf409b6f5a.png] 

Similarly,

UNBIASED : '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7465ef6232ce8ff2556cf9c26bb12aa3f24ed56dcb32c54325b5c932e301fc7a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "OTABISYJ".
